Mia and Sage look for Kento at Mount Dojo and come up against harsh weather, wild wolves, and a determined Cale; Sage must find the power within himself to unlock his armor's full potential, defeat Cale and save Kento and Mia.
Before they can rendezvous with Sage, Kento and Mia, Ryo and Cye set out to rescue Rowen from Dais, who casts illusions that turn the warriors against each other.
The team splits up to learn what Talpa has planned for Rowen, who is lost somewhere in space, hoping they can find a way to reach Rowen before Talpa's forces eliminate him.
Ryo attempts to break free of the dark matrix before it crushes him while his allies on the ground battle Talpa's forces; Anubis shows signs of defiance toward Talpa.
Dais plots to lure the heroes into a trap within the castle gates and separate them from their armor, leaving it up to Mia, Ully and White Blaze to come to the rescue.

As the heroes approach Talpa's castle, the enemy attacks and succeeds in splitting up the team; Sage, Ully and Mia encounter Cale in the subway, but the lack of light underground prevents Sage from using his full power.

20 years after a devastating war, an old man and a young boy named Conan live on Remnant Island; one day, Conan finds a girl named Lana on the shore; when Lana is abducted by soldiers, Conan and his grandfather must spring into action.
Conan travels by plane and sea as he tries to rescue Lana from the clutches of Industria soldiers.
Conan arrives on a small island and meets Jimsy, a boy who has been living in the wild; as Conan gets to know his new friend, the ship Barracuda offers an opportunity to finally reach Industria.
Conan and Jimsy attempt to stow away aboard the Barracuda, but are caught and punished by the ship's captain Dyce; they get to work as the ship heads for Industria.

Following an accident on the job, Satsuki's father is injured, but Leo thinks ghosts are behind it; when the gang investigates the building Satsuki's father worked at, they find that the building itself is alive and eager to have guests stay.

The gang takes a trip to the mountains to stay at a resort run by Satsuki's cousin Miyuki; upon arrival, a young girl tells them that Miyuki is dead; it seems that her ghost still haunts the frozen lake, turning it blood-red.

Satsuki is asked to perform the after-school broadcast when the previous announcers fall ill; it seems the ghost of a deceased broadcast club member has invaded the system, intent on killing anyone that might upstage her.

A headless rider terrorizes the town on the anniversary of what was his death, seeking to decapitate people like himself; when the ghost turns his headlights upon Satsuki, the gang needs to find a way to put him to sleep again, and quickly.
